data: NVIDIA delivered an exceptional fiscal 2024, with revenue reaching $60.9 billion, up 125.9% from $27.0 billion in fiscal 2023. Profitability expanded even faster. Gross profit climbed to $44.3 billion in fiscal 2024 from $15.4 billion in fiscal 2023, translating to a fiscal 2024 gross margin of 72.7%. Operating income surged to $33.0 billion in fiscal 2024 from $4.2 billion a year earlier, lifting the fiscal 2024 operating margin to 54.1%. Net income rose 581.3% to $29.8 billion in fiscal 2024 from $4.4 billion in fiscal 2023, while diluted EPS increased to $1.19 from $0.17. Notably, R&D expense grew only modestly, to $8.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $7.3 billion in fiscal 2023, underscoring substantial operating leverage as revenue scaled far faster than investment spending.
